partners.mechanism_chain: DCC (HGNC:2701) —DISRUPTS→ Netrin-1 signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-1280274); Netrin-1 signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-1280274) —LEADS_TO→ Mirror movements (HP:0001325); Netrin-1 signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-1280274) —LEADS_TO→ Horizontal gaze palsy (HP:0000677); Netrin-1 signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-1280274) —LEADS_TO→ Scoliosis (HP:0002752). Loss-of-function mutations in DCC disrupt the Netrin-1 signaling pathway, which is crucial for neuronal guidance. This disruption leads to abnormal decussation of corticospinal fibers, causing mirror movements (Disease A), and also affects the development and function of brainstem nuclei controlling horizontal eye movements and spinal cord development, leading to horizontal gaze palsy and progressive scoliosis (Disease B).

falsification.text: If genetic or experimental evidence demonstrates that DCC and HJV function in completely independent cellular compartments or signaling cascades with no cross-talk, and that iron homeostasis has no measurable impact on neuronal guidance or development pathways, this hypothesis would be falsified. falsification.gnomad_variant: gnomAD analysis showing common variants (AF > 0.01) in the coding regions of DCC and HJV that are pathogenic for each respective disease would challenge the rarity assumption for these specific disease mechanisms.

partners.mechanism_chain: DCC (HGNC:2769) —DISRUPTS→ axon guidance pathway (GO:0007411); ROBO1 (HGNC:10044) —DISRUPTS→ axon guidance pathway (GO:0007411); axon guidance pathway (GO:0007411) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal corpus callosum morphology (HP:0002079); axon guidance pathway (GO:0007411) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital mirror movements (HP:0002417); axon guidance pathway (GO:0007411) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal ocular motor behavior (HP:0000501); axon guidance pathway (GO:0007411) —LEADS_TO→ Renal agenesis (HP:0000057).
